about.title: Men haqimda
about.paragraph1: Men Polshaning Varshava shahrida yashovchi Computer Engineering talabasi va kelajakdagi Full-Stack dasturchiman.
about.paragraph2: Asosiy yo'nalishim JavaScript va React yordamida frontend dasturlash. Tartibli, moslashuvchan interfeyslar yaratish va g'oyalarni amaliy veb-loyihalarga aylantirish menga yoqadi.
about.paragraph3: Shuningdek, to'liq veb-ilovalar qanday yaratilishini yaxshiroq tushunish uchun backend dasturlash, ma'lumotlar bazalari va ilova arxitekturasini ham o'rganmoqdaman.
